📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-29-methodsession-getaccountbysubdomain-nre`
This is occurrence #33 (last seen 2026-08-11, ~46h ago).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: Confirm synthetic-only via ES aggregate on fields.UserAgent.keyword; if 100% WindowsPowerShell and 0 real browsers, no action needed beyond tracking. NRE in MethodSessionService.GetAccountBySubdomain() triggered only by subdomain-less synthetic probes (account id 0), no real-user impact.
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (1 total, DD-scan-diff synthetic — no Slack MCP this session):
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/299551647 ([VAE][PortalApps][P1] 5xx error rate elevated, fired 2026-08-13T02:04:27Z)

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/299551647
  • ES/Kibana: message.keyword:"JWT Retrieval Failed", 2026-08-13T01:34:27Z-02:04:27Z -> 84 hits, 100% WindowsPowerShell synthetic-probe UserAgent, exact match to documented NRE stack trace (MethodSessionService.GetAccountBySubdomain)
  • This-window concentration: single root cause, dd_service:method.ws/apps 100% of hits

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing`
This is occurrence #49 (last seen 2026-08-09, ~86h ago).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Integrations` (`@integrations` / `#team-integrations`)
Playbook: sibling P1 monitors (296632224 Event ingest stopped, 296636101 Kafka events stopped) both OK/stale (>3wk) -- core EDA pipeline healthy, isolated to this one P3 AMQP-publish-count metric. Benign quiet-traffic-period pattern, self-recovered.
Open Jira: none (fix_status: escalated-for-review, no update from Integrations)

Source alerts (1 total, DD-scan-diff synthetic — no Slack MCP this session):

  • DD metric: sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:eda_consumer,env:prod} over exact 30-min eval window -> 1 total datapoint (1.0 hit at window end), rest empty

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #120 (last seen 2026-08-09, ~4d13h ago).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `unmapped` (team:crm tag, no exact ownership.md project match — see investigation)
Playbook: brief dip below the AMQP-consumer floor threshold, fast self-recovery, 0 errors, no sibling co-fire -- canonical benign quiet-period-flap shape for this 5-monitor family (created 2026-07-02).

Note: a 2nd fire this cycle (302055141, method-mobile-notifications-subscriber heartbeat, +2h39m) hit the same KB entry and was suppressed by same-cycle gate ordering (last_notified_at reset by this post) — independently genuine, logged in docs/actionable/2026-08-13.md, not a duplicate.
